info.description: End-to-end API tests for the 4 Sehat 5 Haji clinic backend (see PRD). Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner or `newman run`. Requires the Postman environment '4 Sehat 5 Haji - Local' and a seeded admin account.

exec: { const v = pm.response.json(); const x = v.data.id; pm.expect(x, "patient_a_id present").to.not.be.undefined; pm.environment.set("patient_a_id", x); }

item.name: Patient A cannot cancel B's appointment
Patient C books after cancel (queue 3, number not reused)

exec: { const v = pm.response.json(); const x = v.data.id; pm.expect(x, "appt_c_id present").to.not.be.undefined; pm.environment.set("appt_c_id", x); }
pm.test("remaining_quota = 0", () => { const s = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.id == pm.environment.get("schedule_id")); pm.expect(s.remaining_quota).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Patient A cannot cancel once arrived
Doctor views queue for the practice date

exec: pm.test("ordered by queue_number", () => { const q = pm.response.json().data.map(x => x.queue_number); pm.expect(q).to.eql([...q].sort((x,y)=>x-y)); });
pm.test("cancelled patient not listed as active", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.id == pm.environment.get("appt_b_id") && x.status !== "cancelled")).to.be.undefined);

item.name: Doctor creates record for A (+ prescriptions)

exec: { const v = pm.response.json(); const x = v.data.id; pm.expect(x, "record_id present").to.not.be.undefined; pm.environment.set("record_id", x); }
pm.test("A completed", () => { const x = pm.response.json().data.find(i => i.id == pm.environment.get("appt_a_id")); pm.expect(x.status).to.eql("completed"); });
